item.title: Meta 携 Muse Spark 1.2 与 Muse Code 杀入 AI 编程大战
item.summary: Meta today released Muse Code, a terminal-based AI coding agent now in beta, alongside Muse Spark 1.2, a coding-focused update to its Muse Spark family of frontier models — a one-two punch that puts the company in direct competition with Anthropic's Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex, and the growing field of agentic coding h
